sample_output.claim_or_url: MCP servers may accept a client’s existing API token and forward it to a downstream API (token passthrough).
sample_output.tldr: Found as a forbidden anti-pattern: the claim is false as policy. MCP security best practices explicitly forbid token passthrough — servers MUST NOT accept tokens that were not issued for that MCP server.

body.policy: Token passthrough is explicitly forbidden (MUST NOT).
body.rule: Servers MUST NOT accept tokens that were not issued for that MCP server.
body.paraphrase: Accepting a client's existing API token and forwarding it downstream is an anti-pattern, not an allowed integration pattern.

sources.title: MCP Security Best Practices
sources.supports: Token passthrough forbidden; MUST NOT; named risks
